description: This file defines an Angular service class `DeviceService` that interacts with a backend server to manage device data. It includes methods to fetch devices, filter by group, refresh data, and retrieve detailed device info, utilizing RxJS for reactive programming.

classes.name: DeviceService
classes.description: Angular injectable service that manages device data fetching and filtering

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Triggers a refresh of the device list by emitting a new value to the refreshSubject.

methods.name: setGroupId
methods.description: Sets the current device group by updating the groupIdSubject.

methods.name: getDevices
methods.description: Returns an observable sequence of devices, filtered by group if set.

methods.name: getDeviceInfo
methods.description: Fetches detailed information for a specific device by deviceId.
